article.body: Tactile Sensing Array developed for multi-phalanx sensing in humanoid hands, as reported in a research paper published on arXiv. The array, made from Velostat and conductive tape, aims to provide tactile feedback across the whole finger for improved manipulation. The design is low-cost and could potentially be replicated at the scale of individual phalanges, making it practical for multi-phalanx sensing. The paper was published on September 28, 2026. (Source: arXiv cs.RO)
